definitions.explanation: A full return to health after illness or injury. Used as a noun or with する to mean 'to recover completely.'

examples.japanese: {全快|ぜんかい}おめでとうございます。
{手術|しゅじゅつ}から{三|さん}か{月|げつ}で{全快|ぜんかい}した。
examples.english: I made a full recovery three months after the surgery.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}から{全快|ぜんかい}の{知|し}らせを{聞|き}いて、{家族|かぞく}みんなで{喜|よろこ}んだ。
examples.english: When we heard the news of a full recovery from the doctor, the whole family celebrated.

notes:
{全快|ぜんかい} is composed of {全|ぜん} (all, complete) + {快|かい} (pleasant, recovery).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全快|ぜんかい}する: to make a full recovery
- {全快|ぜんかい}{祝|いわ}い: celebration of recovery
- {全快|ぜんかい}おめでとう: congratulations on your recovery

SIMILAR WORDS: {回復|かいふく} (recovery) is broader and can refer to partial recovery or recovery of non-health things. {全快|ぜんかい} specifically means a complete return to health.
